decisions.statement: A body whose top level is no object answers no object.
The body's own top-level object is answered apart from any key the body has.
An entry goes with the space before that entry back to where the preceding entry ended.
An entry followed by a comma goes with that comma.
An entry followed by no comma goes back to take the comma before that entry.
An entry dropped straight after its neighbour reaches back for no comma.
An entry the caller does not name is left where that entry is.
No comma is taken twice where neighbours go together.
A run going out of the end takes the comma before that run.
A body a run went out of reads as JSON.
Nothing here reads the disk or an index.
Nothing here rewrites a body.
A body of entries is read one entry to a line.
A key named goes from every entry of a body of entries that states it.
A line holding nothing but space is passed over.
A passage over an entry is placed against the whole body rather than its own line.
A value under the key named is written anew where the caller states a new spelling for that value.
Only the keys the outermost object of an entry states are reached.
A key of the same name nested inside an entry's value is left as it is.
Each element of a value stated as a list is written anew.
A value stated as neither text nor a list is left as it is.
A value the caller states no new spelling for is left as it is.

definition: a key a JSON body holds at its top level
